title: Understanding the role of the hippocampus in representing multimodal stimuli
content:
by Halle R. Dimsdale-Zucker

Although experiences are multimodal, much of the work on the hippocampus has focused on visual stimuli. A new study in PLOS Biology presented unimodal and audiovisual stimuli and found evidence for hippocampal involvement in representing both.
